metadata.research_question: How does the number of distinct source scenarios supporting a typed relationship affect missing-link recovery?
metadata.support_definition: Number of distinct source scenario IDs containing the same normalized subject-predicate-object relationship.
metadata.leakage_control: Target scenario labels and graph edges are removed. Cross-scenario evidence excludes the target scenario.
metadata.label_warning: Evaluation labels represent silver row-level associations, not independently expert-validated causal relationships.
metadata.interpretation_warning: Repeated scenario relationships are not independent physical causal confirmations.
